acceptanceCriteria: A digest-pinned CI integration verifies proof maps without LLM, index, network or Corvint retriever.
Reports are deterministic, bounded and source-content-free while retaining security limitations.
Missing or unsupported evidence fails visibly and cannot produce a success conclusion.
body: Ship one portable verification path after independent interoperability proves the wire boundary.
title: Ship a digest-pinned portable CI verifier
